text: さらに　ポケモンリーグ　ほんぶには　…　もうれつに　つよい！

structure.jp: ポケモンリーグ　ほんぶには　…
もうれつに　つよい！

patterns.name: 〜に (adverb)
patterns.explanation: に after a describing word like もうれつ turns it into a 'how' word, like English -ly. もうれつに　つよい = 'fiercely strong'.

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: に says where, and は added on top makes that place the thing being talked about. ほんぶには = 'at headquarters (as for there)'.
